note: Decision tree of fid_loop.py. change = patch of the job config (merged into the parent's config). pass = next node if the FID beats the control by more than the margin (the change is kept), fail = next node if not (the change is dropped). No node adds a model parameter. follower_only = the node runs only when another node names it. A null follower = the first node of this file that has not run.

ema_teacher.why: Teacher pass with averaged weights (decay 0.999) in place of the trained weights, as in JEPA and self-flow

ema_teacher_slow.why: Slower averaged teacher: decay 0.9999 in place of 0.999

noisy_half.why: Half of the patches at the higher noise level in place of a quarter: a harder student task

noisy_three_quarters.why: Three quarters of the patches at the higher noise level, on top of the gain from one half

noisy_eighth.why: One eighth of the patches at the higher noise level: the opposite direction, after one half failed

teach_weight_2.why: Teaching term at weight 2 in place of 1

teach_weight_4.why: Teaching term at weight 4, on top of the gain from weight 2

teach_weight_half.why: Teaching term at weight 0.5: the opposite direction, after weight 2 failed

block_layout.why: The noisier patches form one rectangle per image (I-JEPA target block) in place of spread patches: the student must use far context

block_half.why: A rectangle of half the image at the higher noise level, on top of the gain from the block layout

teach_noisy_only.why: The teaching term counts only the noisier patches (JEPA: predict the hidden part), not the context patches

pair_early.why: Teaching from block 6 into block 2 in place of block 3: an earlier student layer

pair_last.why: Teaching from the last block (8) into block 4: later layers on both sides, after the earlier student layer failed

weight_logflip.why: Flipped log loss weight in place of the clamp weight: it ended 3.0 FID below the control in the full run without teaching

sample_ema_slow.why: Averaged weights for sampling with decay 0.9995 in place of 0.999: a longer average, no change of training

sample_ema_fast.why: Averaged weights for sampling with decay 0.998: a shorter average, after the longer one failed

readouts_half.why: Half the weight on the low-resolution readout losses: more of the gradient goes to the final image

readouts_double.why: Double weight on the low-resolution readout losses, after half failed

no_teaching.why: Sensitivity test: the teaching term off (mixed noise only). If the FID does not rise, 16,000 steps cannot show the value of teaching

ema_teacher_fast.why: Faster averaged teacher: decay 0.99 in place of 0.999, between the trained weights and the kept setting

teach_half_noisy.why: Two weak gains together: teaching weight 0.5 (124.31) and teaching on the noisier patches only (124.43)

out_align_half.why: View alignment at the output: the student's final image is also pulled to the averaged teacher's final image (weight 0.5). The teacher sees less noise

out_align_2.why: Output alignment at weight 2, on top of the gain from weight 0.5

out_align_tenth.why: Output alignment at weight 0.1, after weight 0.5 failed

no_mixed_noise.why: Ablation: no noisier patches (student and averaged teacher see the same image). Is the gain from the averaged teacher alone?

ema_clean_teacher.why: The averaged teacher sees the clean image. With the trained weights as teacher this changed little on the 3090 (127.67 against 126.78)

teach_weight_quarter.why: Teaching weight 0.25: the weight tests fall slowly with the weight (2: 124.64, 1: 124.39, 0.5: 124.31)

ema_deep_target.why: The averaged teacher gives the target from the last block (8) to block 3. With the trained weights as teacher this cost 0.8 on the 3090
